notes.title: 2023. VINE's NEWS
notes.content:
Hello, everyone.
We are the publisher, OurTurn Games, of VINE.

This year, we have had a joyful year with the release of our first game, VINE.
We also extend our gratitude to FrogParty, who worked hard on development.

VINE was released on June 22, and over the past six months, we have released 32 patches.
The patch versions tested internally exceed 100.

Although we initially planned for DLC or similar updates,
we focused on improving the stability and convenience of the game.

Currently, many people are giving positive feedback on the stability and convenience.

Regardless of this, there are not many players who have reached the ending of VINE.
About 7% of buyers reached the ending within the first two months of the game's release,
but as of December 23, 2023, the percentage is less than 3%.

Yes, that's right. VINE is a challenging game.
But don't we need such games in the world?

Please don't judge by appearances alone.
Those who have played VINE commonly say, "This is unlike any game I've played before. It's different from what I expected."

We appreciate the interest from many people in VINE, created by FrogParty, a solo developer.
We will continue to develop steadily and improve the completeness in 2024.

Thank you.

notes.title: Please provide an update & feedback.
notes.content:
The tutorial that was hastily created for the recent BIC event was quite lacking.
So, it's expected that many players found it difficult to understand the game in the early stages.
Indeed, there were such opinions.

We have developed a new tutorial based on feedback from players who have experienced both
the previous and updated versions through this BIC event, as well as feedback from new players.

This version has received a relatively high level of satisfaction internally as well.
Nonetheless, we will continue to make efforts for ongoing optimization.

We hope that those who have previously played the game will also try playing with
the new controls and provide feedback.

1. Tutorial Mode Added
- Removed the previous tutorial from the Story Mode and developed a separate tutorial
   that can be played individually.
- Adjusted the level design for Chapters 1 and 2.

2. Control Scheme Changes
- Adjusted jump to have a slight forward motion.

notes.title: Update_2023062
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1832130/

VINE Update Patch Notes

1. Updates
1) Chapter Mode
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41644621/a5c571594ff816c6cb6f56e5cb8bd9d387d62358.png

- Fixed an issue where the records were being miscalculated.
- Fixed an issue where the records were not being displayed.
- Fixed an issue where it was possible to perform a double jump while on the surface of water.
- Adjusted the uneven volume of the dubbed voices for better consistency.

notes.title: [Coming soon] VINE, D-30 Release Preparation Status
notes.content:
Hello!
I'm O.T Games in charge of VINE Global Services.

Official Release: June 22, 2023
Tumblbug: https://link.tumblbug.com/9QhQtkSCxzb

#TumblBugRetweetEvent is in progress, and even if the tumbleBuck fails, we will send you a lottery and a gift.

We are informing you of the current situation 30 days before the launch.

1. There is a change in the content of the release version.
VINE had planned to develop and release three modes (easy, normal, and difficult) for fun storytelling while providing a variety of puzzles, but decided that dividing them into three would be meaningless and rather preventing them from focusing on the game.

That's why we're integrating all three modes into one story line.
There is no difference in play time and production volume.

2. Amount of Play
The release content has been developed for an average of 20 hours of play.
Based on the first play, Gosu is expected to be within 15 hours, and if you don't do well, it will be a game that you can't beat for the rest of your life.
210 kinds of puzzles have been developed and are being completed.

3. Localization (Language: 6+2)
It supports a total of six languages: Korean, English, Chinese, Russian, Japanese, and Spanish.
All in-game texts have been translated, and recording for full dubbing is in progress.
We are planning to add German and Portuguese after the release.

4. Events
We are preparing a ranking event using the leaderboard function provided on Steam.
Acrylic goods will be given as gifts, and details will be announced in the future.
It's very advantageous if you try it in Demo.

5. Controllers
It has been developed to support most game pads, including steam decks.


VINE, coming soon!

notes.title: FrogParty & O.T Games Publishing Contract
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41644621/774b2f94216bf0160c67070557fa222b4906d586.gif

Frogparty and O.T Games have signed a VINE publishing contract.

O.T Games will be making various preparations for VINE services, and the rough plan is as follows:

1. Polishing
 - Expand content to increase user satisfaction while maintaining core systems
 - Prepare immersive storylines and puzzles of varying difficulties
 - Generate over twice the content and playtime as the originally planned version

2. Localization
 - Translate into English, Simplified Chinese, and Russian based on Korean
 - Full voice dubbing for Korean, English, Simplified Chinese, and Russian
 - Consider adding additional languages through additional surveys and research

3. Testing
 - Conduct testing more than 3 times before release
 - Recruit small-scale testers of 10-20 people for each test.
 
We will work hard to successfully launch VINE in the second quarter of 2023.

Thank you.
